rationale: C04 owns thermodynamics/statistical mechanics foundations; C09 applies them to condensed matter phases and soft matter.
C07 owns general quantum states, many-particle principles and measurement; C09 applies them to material systems.
C08 owns atomic/molecular structure and light-matter specialization; C09 begins from those accepted microscopic foundations when needed.
C10-C12 remain locked and provide no academic support claims.
General solid-state concepts precede crystal, semiconductor and magnetic specialization.
Electronic/magnetic foundations precede superconductivity and quantum-material extensions.
Soft matter is presented as a distinct condensed-matter branch after general material-state foundations.
